what: REV-DS-1 reviewer's own reference list of founder actions in CHANGELOG lines 240-261 (criterion (e)); built in phase A from the CHANGELOG (261 lines, sha256/16 0d1a9b27aa5fb775), interfaces/mechanical.json v2.4 66bc53d88d444679 (jfwd_v352.founder_rules, requests_v352[3]) and interfaces/electronics.json v4 11f7896ad0d0613b (bench_plan.founder_block). Reviewer data, not a report; nothing here is physical approval.

actions.action: Procure the J-FWD screw ENG-HW-101-IN718 (IN718 bar AMS 5662 aged to AMS 5663, ISO 7380-1 form with the F3 pilot 5.15 h9 and undercut fillet, M5 x 10.7 with spring A / 10.6 with spring B): maker TO-SELECT, drawing TO-DRAW, TO-QUOTE delivered to Sonderborg DK-6400; threads rolled after ageing TO-DEFINE.

Fallback only if IN718 cannot be procured: stock BUMAX 88-MKT M6 x 10 A4-80 (TO-QUOTE); needs a CAD change (d6.6 holes, d11.5 spot faces, M6 taps, FD-04 trim), a tap-wall probe and an FE re-run; a fallback, not a passed design.
J-FWD hole edges: bore-side break R0.1-R0.2 (R0.2 hard maximum), spot-face side 0.1 max, deburr after match-drilling and rework before anodise, 100 % 10x inspection before assembly.
S01 / S02 O-rings replaced after any FA-1-class event, together with the line-231 J-FWD inspection.

Preload-retention audit (founder procedure): J-F1 on the IN718 flight lot calibrates crack-on torque against clamp (load washer, LOCTITE 243 cured); after the first hot fire or a TB soak test, before disassembly, read each screw's crack-on torque and convert to residual clamp; log breakaway torque; 10x inspection for fretting and set.
GSE: ENG-TC-12 J-FWD hole-plug set (TO-DRAW / TO-QUOTE) and ENG-TC-13 registration shoulder screws (TO-DRAW); match-drill fixture with the index pin and guide bushings (shop tooling, TO-DRAW).

J-FWD assembly order C4 (gate J-F1; hole pins GO 5.50 / NO-GO 5.62; tap gauging; plugs and band; S01/S02 lubricant TO-SELECT, oxygen-clean, FKM- and N2O-compatible; clock and push; shoulder 2.00 +/-0.02 on the gap gauge TO-CONFIRM; registration screws first; flight screws one at a time with a new oriented HW-170 at the J-F1 lot torque by M-T1J, never re-torqued; proof / leak test).

T-F1, a GATE before the first static fire: a SOURCED time-at-temperature limit for TC-01 / TC-02 (route (i) handbook data with full citation, or route (ii) coupons from the same heat / lot, >= 3 exposed and 3 control, EN ISO 6892-1 / ASTM B557) on the A 175 rows (A 150 beside); re-basing to A 165 only after B-TC-1 calibrates the channel (lead).

Disc spring HW-170: spring A Schnorr 001 500 A in 1.4568 (baseline), spring B Lesjofors 7909 in 1.4310 (alternate), TO-QUOTE delivered to Sonderborg DK-6400 with relaxation data at about 160 C; SINGLE-USE (scrap on removal); orientation per C9 (1).

J-F1 on the flight lots (screws, springs, LOCTITE 243) with the six spring items; the lot torque set so K_min gives <= 3750 N (J-F1 maximum preload CAPPED at 3750 N; today 2.747 N m, minimum 2057.6 N).
Pressure-film (Fuji Prescale) footprint check at J-F1 (TO-VERIFY; film grade TO-SELECT).
Shoulder-screw registration: two GSE shoulder screws (ENG-TC-13) selected to the pin-gauged holes in two opposite holes first, flight screws one at a time and recorded, shoulder screws out last.
Match-drilling clocking +/-0.25 deg by an index pin in the drill fixture.

SINGLE-USE J-FWD screws until C6 closes (new at every assembly, never reused or re-torqued); removed screws kept per hole and inspected at 10x with dye penetrant at the thread root AND the head-to-shank fillet, as data.
C6 closure path 3: a screw qualification test (TO-DEFINE, founder / test owner).

J-F1b: 5 J-F1 joints cycled 20 -> 175 C -> 20 C, >= 10 min at the peak from when the spring flat reaches it, 10 cycles, residual preload and breakaway recorded; METHOD TO-DEFINE (uniform oven only if the LOCTITE 243 range covers 175 C, else local heating with the tap temperature recorded).
LOCTITE 243 service range and hot-strength fractions TO-VERIFY against the Henkel TDS (founder action).

Post-abort joint replacement rule: after any case-TC (OVER_TEMP, F-14) or TB-state abort (HW_OVERPRESSURE, PC_OVERPRESSURE, HARD_START, PC_SENSOR HIGH >= 4.75 V = 146.5 bar abs) the J-FWD joint counts as used: HW-101 and HW-170 replaced, TC-01 holes and TC-02 taps gauged before the next run.
B-TC-1 bench row: verify tau <= 0.25 s and the static terms on the DESIGN install (else the tolerance is re-derived), plus the CJTO trim step and a mean-shift EMI pass (R3-03).

Stand T0 rule (F-13): B1-length stand burns only with the engine soaked at a stand ambient <= 24 C (facility thermometer, +/-0.5 K, with the soak condition); the founder pre-fire checklist row is the control (firmware ARM refusal above 24 C is a backstop); re-derive after B-TC-1.
Pc transducer proof >= 166.14 bar abs (1.1 x FA1S 151.04): C1 Kulite XTL-190SM-2000A (206.8 bar abs) meets it; the 070BG (stand) must meet it or be isolated (Electronics v2.12).

TC-02 plug OD SELECT FIT (R2-B) to its own measured TC-01 bore: radial gap [0.040, 0.0631] mm, D_meas - 0.1262 <= OD <= D_meas - 0.080 mm, less 2U (U TO-DEFINE, shop); bore and OD measured at 20 +/- 1 C with paired serials; TC-02 OD finished last from a blank with finishing stock.

Electronics founder block F-1..F-14: RFQs BOM 237, 238, 244, 245, 250, 251 (delivered to DK-6400); F-7 TE 070BG, F-8 PCB 113B22, F-9 NI 9234 inquiries; F-10 Kulite XTL-190SM-2000A inquiry; F-11 anemometer mast and logger; F-12 spare-070BG over-range row; F-13 stand T0 rule; F-14 J-FWD rule.
F-10 also asks Kulite for the thermal-zero maximum and a 100 F compensated band from the coldest ARM to the hottest relight seat (R3-05); B-PC-1 measures the zero coefficient per serial.
Status: bench plan v4 is REVISE (text) and does not go to the founders before v5 (no bench row is executed from v4).

CF-4 / B-BLEED-1: measured Cd x A of the two-tap path >= 0.91 x the Cd 0.70 value (>= 0.95 x with the FD-01 element bound) else re-size; line stays unlined; after CF-4 re-set kPurgeFlow_s and the both-open cap from the measured Cd x A (297.15 K mass flow; overlap <= 76 g / mdot(297.15 K) - (t_close - t_open)), never above 2.43 / 2.39 s; (d1) on the upper 95 % bound of the measured N2O Cd x A; (d2) CF-4 shows the 283.15 K need at the re-set flow; without the re-set, Cd x A <= 1.08 x the Cd 0.70 value or GNC re-runs the reserve test.

Q_JFWD rule: Q_JFWD = max(head peak, head ESP at 0.2-0.5 ms) > 60.0 bar abs at any time in a run (no minimum duration) -> the line-231 J-FWD inspection (C6 (2)) and the TC-02 taps gauged (M5-6H GO / NO-GO) before the next run; a noise-driven trigger on a measured stand trace still means the inspection until a noise-floor rule is derived and reviewed.
Stand: a no-event B-DPC-1 record (TO-VERIFY) before the stand use of the Z3 v2 / Q_JFWD post-run checks.

T4 re-sized to the shortest firing (B1 p99 burn 21.76 s, coast about 19 s, one relight about 4.6 s at about 0.47 throttle): planning about 2.0 kg of N2O [ESTIMATE] against 7.02 kg; the T4 rows of T1-T4 stay the DC-D computation until Combustion re-runs them (OPEN, Combustion).
